report:
## Question
Does intervention X reduce outcome Y?

## Scope and As-of Date
Published literature through 2026.

## Method
Searched PubMed and OpenAlex; resolved DOIs and checked URLs.

## Findings
Intervention X reduced outcome Y with a moderate effect size [S1]. A second trial reported a smaller effect [S2].

## Counterevidence
One contradicted record questions the pooled interpretation [S3].

## Limitations
Small samples; limited long-term follow-up.

## Source Register
See sources.md.
